verses.1: And all the children of Israel went out. The assembly gathered together as one person, to the land of Dan, to Be’er Sheva, and to the land of Gilgal, before the LORD our God.
verses.2: And all the people, all the tribes of Israel, stood together in one place, before the Lord’s people. There were four hundred thousand men who stood there.
verses.3: And the sons of Benyamin heard that the Israelites had gone up to the mountains. So the Israelites said, “What will become of this bad thing?”
verses.4: And the Levite man, the man of the woman who was killed, said, “The girl who came to me with her hair cut off… I will cut my hair and go with them.”
verses.5: They stood on top of me, the men of Giv’ah. They covered me with their bodies during the night. They made me feel like a victim. My limbs were injured, and I died.
verses.6: And I will hold it in my hands, and I will scatter it over all the fields of Israel. For they have done evil and rebellion in Israel.
verses.7: Now, all of you, children of Israel, I give you a command and a advice.
verses.8: And all the people became one man, saying, “No one shall go into his tent, and no one shall enter his house.”
verses.9: And now, this is what happened to her: she became a source of shame and disgrace.
verses.10: And we took twelve men for each hundred of Israel’s tribes. For every hundred people, we took one thousand men to serve as leaders among the people. This was done so that they could lead them in battle against Benjamin, just as all the other leaders did during Israel’s time.
verses.11: And all the people of Israel gathered together in one place, as if they were one group of friends.
verses.12: And they sent officials from all the tribes of Israel, saying, “What is this evil that has happened to you?”
verses.13: And now, give over these people who are sons of Belial. They will die, and there will be a great disaster in Israel. And the sons of Benjamin will not be able to hear the voices of their brothers among the Israelites.
verses.14: And the sons of Benyamin were gathered from all the towns in the region, in order to go into battle against the sons of Israel.
verses.15: And on that day, the sons of Benyamin were stationed in those cities. There were forty and six thousand men who were tasked with destroying the ruins. Seven thousand men were stationed in each city.
verses.16: From all this people, seven thousand were chosen as leaders. They were placed on the right side of God. All of them carried stones to build the temple. And they did not commit any sins.
verses.17: And the men of Israel were alone in Benjamin. There were four thousand five hundred men who were involved in the destruction of the city. Each of these men was a soldier in that war.
verses.18: They stood up and went into the Temple. They asked God for help. They said, “Children of Israel, who will lead us into battle against the children of Benyamin at the beginning?” God replied, “Jehuda will lead us at the beginning.”
verses.19: And the children of Israel stood up in the morning and camped on the hill.
verses.20: And an Israelite man went out to war against Benyamin. An Israelite man prepared himself for battle against him.
verses.21: And the sons of Benyamin went out from their camp. On that day, they destroyed two hundred and ten thousand people in Israel.
verses.22: And the people of Israel became stronger. They prepared to fight in the place where they had fought on the first day.
verses.23: And the children of Israel went up and bowed down before Jehovah until morning. They asked Jehovah, “Increase our strength to fight against the children of Benyamin, my brother.” And Jehovah said to them, “Go up against them.”
verses.24: And the children of Israel came before the children of Benjamin on the second day.
verses.25: And Benyamin went out to call them. On the second day, he destroyed them among the children of Israel. About ten thousand men died from this destruction. All of them were killed by the sword.
verses.26: And all the children of Israel and all the people came together. They entered the Temple, bowed down, and sat down before Jehovah. They remained there until evening. Then they ascended the stairs and offered sacrifices before Jehovah.
verses.27: And the children of Israel asked about Jehovah. And there was also the place where the covenant of God was made on those days.
verses.28: And Pinchas, son of Elazar, son of Ahron, stood before him on those days and said, “Let us still go out to war against the children of Benyamin, my brother. If I do not stop, then the LORD will say that we must fight against them tomorrow.”
verses.29: And Israel set up markers around the land.
verses.30: And the children of Israel went up to the children of Benjamin on the third day. They planted seeds in the fields, one by one.
verses.31: And the sons of Benyamin went out to speak to the people. They were taken out of the city, and they began to beat the people repeatedly. This happened over and over again, in the days when one cart carried things into the house of God, and another cart was used for carrying goods in the field. There were thirty men in Israel at that time.
verses.32: And the sons of Benyamin said, “They are weak before us, just as they were before. And the sons of Israel said, ‘Let us capture them and take them from the city to the camps.’”
verses.33: And all the men of Israel rose up from their places. They gathered together in the place called Timnath. All of Israel came from their places, from every corner of the land.
verses.34: And twelve thousand men came from among the Israelites, who were chosen ones from all of them. They were brave warriors, but they did not know that evil was about to strike them.
verses.35: And Jehovah destroyed Binyamin before Israel. The children of Israel were destroyed in Binyamin that day. It was forty-five thousand one hundred men who were destroyed. All of them were destroyed by destruction.
verses.36: And the sons of Benyamin saw that they had been defeated. So the Israelites gave Benyamin a place to stay, because they trusted in the Lord who was located on the high ground.
verses.37: And the army rushed forward, and they spread out across the field. They captured the entire city.
verses.38: And the task was assigned to an Israelite man from the East, so that he could carry the smoke from the city away.
verses.39: And Israel became a warlike people in that battle. In Niniam, they began to kill foreigners among the Israelites. Thirty men were killed because they said, “He is too strong for us.” But in that first battle, he was defeated by us.
verses.40: And the smoke began to rise from the city. It spread out in all directions. And suddenly, the entire city was covered in smoke.
verses.41: And one of the Israelites became terrified. In Nimin, a man was so frightened that he thought evil had been done to him.
verses.42: And they turned toward the path leading to the sea and the battlefield. This path was filled with ruins from destroyed cities.
verses.43: They set up a platform for him to stand on. They guided him there, until he reached the point where the sun rose from the east.
verses.44: And from Binyamin, Shimon, there fell down twelve thousand men. All these were the people of Chayil.
verses.45: And they turned around and rushed towards the steep rock. Five thousand men climbed up the rock, and they attacked from all sides. Thousands of men were killed by them.
verses.46: And all those who fell were forty thousand five hundred men. They were all killed that day by the destruction.
verses.47: And they turned around and rushed towards the steep rock, which was six cubits high. They settled down on that steep rock for forty days.
verses.48: And the Israelites returned to the children of Benjamin. They burned everything they found along the way, from cities to villages. All the cities they encountered were destroyed by fire.
